protocol.fusion: Identical local median and positive score std, square-root-of-two confidence for two signals and dense-only when BM25 misses. Fixed grid changes only weights.
protocol.budget: 100 output records, with same adjacency adapter. Candidate depths 100 and 200 per route.
protocol.quality: Micro evidence recall at 20/100. Pareto axes are overall R@20 and R@100, with an optional third axis of BEAM R@100. Unique scored candidates are a workload proxy. SQLite and end-to-end latency are not timed.
protocol.auto: QARF: unsupervised IDF. Scope held-out mean: other scopes' mean QARF weight within the same dataset, no annotation. Score separation: ratio of standardized top-20 separation from median, uses current candidate scores only. None adds a new retrieval route.
protocol.heldOutGridChoice: Uses labels from both other benchmark datasets to choose the grid point with best macro R@100, ties broken by macro R@20.

economyRecall.protocol: The actual shared automatic recall renderer, frozen authorized candidates and scores. Rerank three or two routes as declared, then render using per-item 160 code points and the shared per-tier character caps. No live host attachment, status or feedback history. Source recall counts gold accessible by selecting delivered references; preview recall counts literal visible annotated matches in the 160-code-point preview. No answer generation.

typescriptParity.method: Plain TypeScript Node replay. Candidate-local median and population standard deviation over positive raw scores; fixed 6:1 vector-to-BM25 ratio; previous adjacent-source completion.

integratedSqlite.protocol: Actual MemoryEngine + SQLite read snapshots and evidence, cached query vectors. Three repetitions balanced forward/reverse, omit first. Each normal/economy comparison has matching evidence limit; normal includes tessera lookup. Does not include the daemon, host, provider round-trip or rendering.
